text: Managing a team is not easy, but good leaders can learn the key skills. First, clear communication is essential. You must explain goals and tasks so everyone understands them. Second, delegation helps a lot. You cannot do everything yourself, so trust your team members with important work. Third, give regular feedback. Praise good work and suggest improvements in a kind way. Motivation is also important. Happy, motivated people work harder and stay longer. Finally, learn to handle conflict. When people disagree, listen to both sides and find a fair solution. With these skills, any team can succeed.
